Author: WowLookThatGuy
Name: Retainer Gear Optimizer
Description:
Cycles through every retainer at a summoning bell and equips each combat (DoW/DoM) retainer with the highest item level gear it can wear from your main inventory (Inventory 1-4). The armoury chest is ignored. Gathering retainers are skipped for now.

Open a summoning bell, then use /rgo start or the Start button in /rgo.
Punchline: Equip your combat retainers with the highest item level gear in your inventory.
